text_copy_copy.text:
Advanced pain therapies

Advanced pain therapies refer to specialized, minimally invasive treatments designed to help manage pain and increase mobility, particularly when non-surgical methods haven't been successful in relieving symptoms.11

standaloneimage.alt: Bone tumor ablation (BTA) is a minimally invasive procedure for patients suffering from debilitating metastatic bone tumors

text_copy_copy_copy.text:
Bone tumor ablation

Bone tumor ablation (BTA) is a minimally invasive procedure for patients suffering from debilitating metastatic bone tumors by combining components of our two core competencies: vertebral access and radiofrequency ablation.

standaloneimage.alt: Vertebral augmentation is a minimally invasive procedure that can be done on an outpatient basis

text_copy_copy_copy_.text:
Vertebral augmentation 

Vertebral augmentation is a minimally invasive procedure that can be done on an outpatient basis. The specific types include vertebroplasty, which involves directly injecting cement and kyphoplasty, which uses a balloon to create space before the bone cement is introduced.12

text_1373857313.text:
Our latest innovation

OptaBlate® basivertebral nerve ablation system

Built on experience. Designed for efficiency.

text.text: Targeting everything we know about pain to the basivertebral nerve (BVN), we've continued to advance the science of delivering large lesions fast.5 The OptaBlate BVN system is a targeted, minimally invasive procedure that provides long-lasting†† vertebrogenic pain relief.6

standaloneimage.alt: Introducing OptaBlate BVN; We’re targeting everything we know about pain to the basivertebral nerve

standaloneimage_copy.alt: The OptaBlate Straight and Curve probe kits provides a minimally invasive approach to help treat patients suffering from debilitating metastatic bone tumors

text_copy_copy.text:
OptaBlate® radiofrequency (RF) generator system

You’ve been waiting. We’ve been innovating.

The OptaBlate Straight and Curve probe kits provides a minimally invasive approach to help treat patients suffering from debilitating metastatic bone tumors.

mild® system

Getting patients back on their feet7

The mild procedure addresses a major root cause of lumbar spinal stenosis (LSS) by removing excess ligament tissue to restore space in the spinal canal and does not significantly alter the structural anatomy of the spine.7,8

standaloneimage.alt: The mild procedure addresses a cause of lumbar spinal stenosis (LSS) by removing excess ligament tissue to restore space in the spinal canal
Expand your vertebral compression fracture (VCF) treatment possibilities with the SpineJack system

text_copy_copy.text:
SpineJack® system

The SpineJack system gives you the tools to take control, restore anatomy and protect your patients from adjacent level fractures.9

standaloneimage.alt: Together, the MultiGen 2 radiofrequency generator and Venom cannula and electrode system delivers large, minimally invasive lesions

text_copy_copy_copy.text:
MultiGen® 2 radiofrequency generator and Venom cannula and electrode system

The innovative Venom system offers an alternative configuration at the distal end with a 'V' shape active tip.

standaloneimage.alt: Our OmniCurve curved balloon system aims to make your perioperative experience more predictable

text_copy_copy_copy.text:
OmniCurve® curved balloon system

Create equal or larger voids through a single incision.10 OmniCurve curved balloon system delivers greater efficiency and safety while treating fractures.5

Medical education

Innovation isn’t the only place we’re relentless. Our Medical Education team is driven to offer comprehensive trainings and events that can be customized to suit your needs.

Whether you’re looking to learn about a specific product, procedure and/or the disease states, take advantage of our broad and ever-expanding Medical Education opportunities.
